why: Replaces the live getter with a value copied at construction. `route-ui.ts` reads `deps.initialVersusConfig` at CLICK time, and the route host is built before any session exists, so a snapshot is permanently `null`: the Versus Setup pane never prefills at all, for anyone, ever. Compiles cleanly and reads like a simplification, which is what makes it worth pinning. 2 of 18: 'is read LIVE, so a config set after construction reaches the pane' and 'survives the session that set it'. The third case, 'starts null, so a fresh page opens the pane on an empty form', keeps passing by construction -- it asserts the value this mutation hardcodes, which is what makes the trio a real discrimination rather than a single-value echo.
